method: outside-in, single fetch per user agent, standard library, no scraping of any engine

findings.headline: Host bot challenge (siteground) intercepts every identity tested, including a plain browser
findings.fix: Crawlers that do not run JavaScript never get past a meta-refresh challenge. Confirm in the host's bot-protection settings which AI crawlers are allowlisted, and check server logs for GPTBot, PerplexityBot and ClaudeBot hits and their status codes. Google Search Console is the authority for Googlebot.

findings.headline: Whether real AI crawlers can read the homepage cannot be determined from this network

evidence.reason: browser identity was challenged too; AI-crawler blocking and IP-level challenge are indistinguishable here

findings.fix: Re-run from a second network, or read the host's bot-protection allowlist and server logs.

findings.headline: robots.txt sits behind the siteground challenge from this network (status 202)
findings.fix: Read it from a browser or a second network; the AI-crawler policy cannot be assessed until then.

findings.headline: Sitemap sits behind the siteground challenge from this network
findings.fix: Read it from a browser or a second network.

findings.headline: Homepage could not be read by a browser or Googlebot from this vantage point
findings.fix: Verify from a second network before concluding anything about the page.

findings.headline: Search Console: indexing status, rich-result types, crawl errors
findings.fix: Needs Search Console access. Until then this stays pending, not assumed.

findings.headline: What ChatGPT, Perplexity or AI Overviews say about the business
findings.fix: Human-run 20-question baseline on two named engines, recorded with date, engine, query and citations. Never scraped.
